paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Sanhedrin, chapter 6, halakhah 5: he and R' Avudemi, the son of R' Tavi’s daughter, reported [a teaching] in the name of R' Yoshiyah.[^1]

notes.text: Explicit 6h 5 remains without a new named passage check. בר ברתיה is a relational maternal-grandson description, not the quasi-name Bar Barteia. Both joint reporters and Yoshiyah attribution remain; a teaching is a bracketed object not quoted by Hyman. The inherited provisional heading and unreviewed entry boundaries remain unadjudicated. All four abbreviated personal titles remain R'.
